value.rationale: The graph is the smallest triple complete-graph product with two equal three-element factors; its 144-element automorphism group naturally enlarges the 72-element separate-coordinate subgroup. A unique subgroup invariant three-dimensional homology class is negated by the equal-axis interchange, so the full quotient is rationally acyclic. The five irreducible constituents refine the previously known 14-sphere count by a meaningful symmetry obstruction.
